grades.label: Continuation Requirements
grades.text: Students who do not maintain at least a 2.40 CGPA will be placed on probation within the School.

grades.label: Continuation Requirements
grades.text: Each term, these students must consult an advisor prior to enrollment and must achieve either a term 2.40 term GPA or an improved CGPA.
